report.rationale: E07 routes acquisition to the purchased active lanes. E12 excludes actuator_stiction, E13 excludes circulation_loss, and E20 excludes none_of_the_above; sensor_bias is absent from all three compatible sets. Confidence rests on this joint intersection, not on treating the lanes as independent confirmations. Unverified shared provenance remains a limitation.

E07 establishes the active lanes, and E19 establishes normal polarity. Controller_timing_fault is the unique intersection of the compatibility sets in E12, E13, and E20. Actuator_stiction conflicts with E12, circulation_loss with E13, none_of_the_above with E20, and sensor_bias with all three. No acquired evidence contradicts the diagnosis under the supplied mappings.
